user_input: Migrate the Entire Front end to React without Changning anything
title: Legacy HTML frontend to React

assessment_snapshot.intro: The project contains a multi-page static frontend for a Returnable Gate Pass / delivery challan system:
bullets: Existing pages include login, dashboard, challan form/detail, admin, and change-password screens
Existing styling is in frontend/css/style.css and frontend/css/login.css
The current frontend loads JavaScript files from frontend/js and communicates with the existing backend
Reference screenshots are attached in the project root as Screenshot (29).png through Screenshot (32).png and image (2).png

proposed_outcome: Rewrite the existing frontend in React while preserving the current screens, styling, routes/URLs, API contracts, authentication behavior, form validation, downloads, and all user-visible workflows. Do not modify the backend or intentionally change product behavior.
